In this notebook, I will make plots for Supplemental Figure 5

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

colCellgroups <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "Set1")[c(1:5,7)]
names(colCellgroups) <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")
```

# Differential Expression

```{r}
de.ccduc.ibdassoc.df <- read_csv("out/deseq2/DE__UCvscCD_IBDAssoc.csv")
de.ccduc.ibdassoc.df
```

```{r}
de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.df <- de.ccduc.ibdassoc.df %>% filter(annotation == "IBDAssocEpi")
de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.df

de.ccduc.ibdassoc.fibro.df <- de.ccduc.ibdassoc.df %>% filter(annotation == "IBDAssocFibro")
de.ccduc.ibdassoc.fibro.df

de.ccduc.ibdassoc.monomac.df <- de.ccduc.ibdassoc.df %>% filter(annotation == "IBDAssocMonoMac")
de.ccduc.ibdassoc.monomac.df
```

```{r, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=7.5}
de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.range <- de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.df$log2FoldChange %>% range %>% abs %>% max %>% ceiling
de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.range <- c(-de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.range, de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.range)

ggplot(de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.df %>% 
         mutate(labelname = ifelse(padj <= 0.01, gene, NA)) %>% 
         mutate(diagSub = ifelse(sign(stat) == 1, "UC", "cCD")) %>% 
         mutate(pointfill = ifelse(padj <= 0.05, diagSub, "Not DE")) %>% 
         mutate(diagSub = fct_relevel(diagSub, c("cCD", "UC"))), 
       aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), label = labelname)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, lty = 2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, lty = 2) +  
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", aes(fill = pointfill)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(color = pointfill, size = -log10(padj)), seed = thisseed-1,
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 75, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 2) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(size = -log10(padj)), color = "black", seed = thisseed-1,
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 75, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec, limits = c("cCD", "UC")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(diagSubColVec, "Not DE" = "gray50"), limits = c("cCD", "Not DE", "UC"), 
                    labels = c("cCD" = "Enriched in cCD", 
                               "Not DE" = "Not DE", 
                               "UC" = "Enriched in UC")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1,4)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = de.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.range) +
  labs(
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    size = "Percent Expression",
    x = "Average Log2 FC",
    y = "-Log10 P Value (Adjusted)",
    title = "IBD-Associated Colonic Epithelial Cells"
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color=colCellgroups["ColEpi"]),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", color="black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color="black"), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  ) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 8)))
```

# GSEA

```{r}
gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.df <- read_csv("out/gsea/GSEA__UCvscCD_IBDAssoc.csv")
gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.df
```

```{r}
gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.df <- gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.df %>% filter(annotation == "IBDAssocEpi")
gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.df

gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.fibro.df <- gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.df %>% filter(annotation == "IBDAssocFibro")
gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.fibro.df

gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.monomac.df <- gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.df %>% filter(annotation == "IBDAssocMonoMac")
gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.monomac.df
```

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=9}
gsea.ccduc.ibdassoc.epi.df %>% 
  filter(NES < 0) %>% 
  filter(padj <= 0.05) %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 5) %>%
  mutate(pathway = str_wrap(pathway, width = 35)) %>% 
  mutate(NES = -NES) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(pathway, NES), x = NES)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=-log10(padj)), col = "black", lwd = 1.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "gray80", high = colcCD, limits = c(1,13), breaks = c(1,4,7,10,13)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1,3)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3)) +
  labs(
    y=NULL, 
    fill = "Adjusted\nPvalue\n(-Log10)",
    x="Normalized Enrichment Score",
    title="Reactome Pathways Enriched in cCD\nIBD-Associated Colonic Epithelial Cells"
  ) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = colCellgroups["ColEpi"]),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", vjust = 0.75),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```
